claims_to_avoid: Do not pool both models as64 independent worlds; they share32 worlds.
Do not treat3072 answers or768 co-referring pairs as independent cases.
Do not call the6 intervention-validation worlds behaviorally untouched or final confirmation; their old outputs determined eligibility.
Do not call the9-cell decomposition another6 independent worlds; it reuses the opened validation cohort.
Do not equate5/8 discovery FIRST-TOKEN successes with5 completed-answer repairs.
Do not compare discovery5.555 accepted-variant logsumexp gain directly with decomposition4.214 canonical-token logit-margin gain without naming different metrics/cohorts.
Do not equate the4.214-nat continuous shift or changed native logits with completed-answer repair; full-head repaired0/8.
Do not infer causal irrelevance from unchanged answers: native distributions changed in all18 full-head questions.
Do not infer missing identity representation from Phi21/512 bare-ID score; most outputs use an Object prefix.
Do not silently regrade Object-prefixed IDs or home-prefixed values as primary successes; response-format diagnostics are post hoc.
Do not label69 Phi eligible wrong-object pairs as all coreference inconsistencies:87 have one correct answer and97 produce different strings.
Do not claim broad unrelated-alias preservation from10 protected facts; they are other fields of the recipient queries, not arbitrary outside entities.
Do not claim discovery selection was gold-blind: E/W labels select/rank heads on development; only the kernel operations omit answer labels.
Do not claim color-profile sources were field-blind or pre-question; those donors see their color question.
Do not treat same-field full-head copying as evidence of an abstract entity variable, or as a mathematical performance upper bound.
Do not call nonrecord residual a pure nonrecord-value factor without noting CPU/native contraction residual.
Do not claim random controls are dose-matched to every branch; they match only full-head norm.
Do not claim a unique causal explanation for failed generalization from tiny ID/field/template subgroups; they covary.
Do not claim no entity representation or no alternative circuit exists; the null is scoped to the selected interface/operator/cohort.
No Phi causal replication occurred; second-model evidence is behavioral only.
No final64-world confirmation outputs were forwarded or inspected.
A zero damage count or degenerate bootstrap interval does not prove zero population risk.
Local hash-pinned registrations are not public prospective registrations.
Public data/code archival and persistent public links are not established merely by these private checksums.

decomposition.continuous_metric_scope: Descriptive canonical single-token E probability over the FULL vocabulary and E-minus-fixed-old-W margin on eight old errors only. Not accepted-variant sums, whole-answer accuracy, new mechanism evidence or confirmation. Six reopened development worlds.

whole_answer_assessment.scope: Six previously opened development worlds; exploratory diagnosis only. A full natural-head transfer is a comparator, not a mathematical performance bound or proof of entity abstraction. Random control matches only the full-head delta norm, not factor doses.

selection_rule.failure_policy: If no signature is eligible, report failure; do not use model outputs to select or expand candidates.
selection_rule.signature_choice: Choose the lexicographically smallest length-signature tuple whose group has at least eight words from at least two declared categories.
selection_rule.within_group_choice: Round-robin category_order; take the earliest remaining word in each category according to the original declared candidate order; skip exhausted categories; stop after eight words.

cohort_selection.eligibility: Correct co-referring donor on all3 factual fields plus identity; recipient has at least1 completed same-field wrong listed-object answer. Select one condition/world by seeded hash; one erroneous screen field by seeded hash. Fourteen worlds eligible, first8 discovery and remaining6 intervention validation. All32 were behavior-screened first.

protocol.answer_rule: Normalize case, whitespace and final punctuation of the entire decoded answer. Explanations or extra non-whitespace lines are not silently truncated. Keep malformed answers as errors.
causal_next_stage_required_before_confir: Freeze a narrowly localized component, strength, eligible-case rule and particular predicted wrong object using development only.
A single donor computation captured at ALIAS_END before seeing any requested field must be reused unchanged for color, shape and home.
Test matched restoration and reverse induction of the particular wrong object's corresponding values; mere accuracy loss is insufficient.
Report unconditional performance and protected unrelated facts/identity/status alongside selected-error repair.
Compare self, norm-matched random, input-name swap, other-object donor and broad-state replacement controls.
Freeze quantitative lexical/record-position/Focus retrieval-mixture baselines before opening all 64 confirmation worlds.
Separate second-model replication and wording-specific failures; no architectural-generalization claim from one passing model.

counterbalance.between_worlds: Within each split: all 16 target-record/first-alias-line position combinations equally often; each object ID and each alias-line position equally often; both co-reference line orders equally often; each of eight lexical names equally often in every semantic alias role; two wording formats equally often. Other pairwise combinations are randomized, not promised fully factorial.
counterbalance.facts: Four distinct values per field, with each complete ordered object-to-field assignment unique across the 96 new worlds. Value lexemes recur; worlds are not lexically disjoint.
counterbalance.within_world: Two consistent swaps of the co-referring names crossed with no Focus, first co-referring name, second co-referring name, and unrelated name. Facts and bindings do not change.

protocol.gate_interpretation: Discordant pairs must have one correct answer and one completed answer selecting another listed object in the requested field; malformed/truncated discordance does not qualify. Per-model feasibility only, not significance, novelty or publication readiness. Failure stops mechanism search for that model without prompt rescue. One passing model permits only one-model exploratory work.
protocol.independent_unit: A newly sampled world; name swaps, Focus conditions and questions are repeated measures, not new worlds.
protocol.purpose: Replicate and explain wrong-object selection, not demonstrate a successful general entity edit.
protocol.statistics: Report all cases, world-level rates and deterministic 2,000-resample percentile intervals resampling whole worlds. Paired comparisons retain every repeat of the sampled world. Development intervals are descriptive after earlier exploratory results.
protocol.stop_rules: Stop a model's mechanism search if the feasibility gate fails. Stop a broad novelty claim if counterbalancing removes the effect, known retrieval mixtures suffice, or only answer copying/broad disruption repairs it. Retain failed and negative runs.

token_only_alias_selection.rule: Lexicographically smallest common input-frame signature with at least eight candidates and two categories; round-robin fruit/animal/object preserving declared candidate order. Full rendered geometry still must pass before inference.

routing_head_selection.practical_pass: newly correct first tokens>=2/8; mean Dcolor accepted-label margin gain>=0.5; Dcolor-minus-leave-one-world-out mean gain>=0.25
routing_head_selection.ranking: descending positive score, then layer, then head; select2
routing_head_selection.support: all4 context record totals>=1e-4 and each recipient-screen record mass>=1e-8
routing_head_selection.validation_winner_order: among passing heads, descending Dcolor-minus-LOOW gain, then Dcolor gain, then newly correct, then layer/head
